style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Oversized Christmas Wreath with Velvet Bow
style.toneOfVoice: Bold, beautiful, and impossible to miss—this gorgeous 80cm oversized artificial wreath is the statement piece your space has been waiting for. Lush, lifelike greenery forms a full, luxurious base, while a rich velvet bow and classic white berries add a touch of timeless elegance and softness. Perfect for front doors, large feature walls, fireplaces, or event spaces, this wreath brings all the drama of fresh foliage without the upkeep. Whether you’re decorating for the holidays or adding a touch of year-round charm, this piece delivers instant wow-factor. Elevate your décor with a wreath that’s as grand as it is graceful. Wreath width: D80cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
